title: JANUS Genesis Durable Face Control v6.1 — Runtime Execution Receipt
verified_behaviors: append-only JSONL control events form a sequence-checked SHA-256 prev-hash chain
new journal instance can replay cancellation, NO_EFFECT reconciliation, and replacement authorization into a deterministic recovery projection
manual modification of a journaled payload without recomputing the chain is detected as JOURNAL_INTEGRITY_ERROR
journal append path uses exclusive file locking, flush, and fsync before returning the entry
two stores sharing one SQLite fence database cannot both hold the same unexpired effect fence through the tested acquisition path
lease expiry/takeover increments fencing generation and makes the prior token stale
same protected effect across original and recovery authorization receives the same provider idempotency key when the provider contract declares idempotency support
non-idempotent provider contracts produce receipt-lookup or external-reconciliation retry policy instead of silent retry
journaled dispatch intent is durable and fenced before the control plane returns it
competing holder is blocked while the fence is live
receipt observation is journaled and the fence release permits a subsequent higher generation
deadline-aware fairness honors overdue work but bounded deadline bursts cannot starve a mandatory old ticket indefinitely in the tested queue
v18.7.22 authority epoch tests remain compatible
v18.7.21 base microcontrol tests remain compatible

runtime_safety_boundary.meaning: The module verifies a durable/fenced control-plane surface using local file and SQLite primitives. It does not itself perform external world effects and does not convert local fencing into a distributed consensus claim.
